source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey,

The account is funded and I am ready to make this official. Welcome to the team.

Here is your confirmed offer:

**FLAT RETAINER: $400-500 per month**
For 100 approved clips per month. Approved means approved by me personally — if a clip does not meet the standard it does not count toward your monthly quota. Quality is everything here.

**YOUR INSTAGRAM ACCOUNT**
You will be assigned your own dedicated Instagram account. You post your approved clips directly to that account. Every clip is tracked — views, performance, engagement — full transparency at all times.

**PERFORMANCE BONUSES**
On top of your flat retainer, every clip that hits a view milestone earns you a bonus. The better your clips perform the more you earn on top of your base. This is your opportunity to earn well above the flat fee every single month.

**NEXT STEPS**
\- I will send you the official Upwork contract shortly
\- Once you accept you will receive your Instagram account login
\- You start posting immediately

This is real. This is long term. And this is just the beginning — the path to Lead Clipper and $2,000 per month is open to you from day one.

Let us build something great together.

Cleavon
